verdict.line: You lose this lane when you walk into Rupture's knockup and eat a close-range Feast; you win it by poking from outside 950 range and letting Toxic Shot stacks pile up.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's Rupture (Q) reaches 950 range at level 1, out-ranging Teemo's 680-range Blinding Dart and his autoattacks, so Cho can poke and zone Teemo safely for free early. But Teemo never needs to approach to trade — Toxic Shot (E) procs on every autoattack with no cooldown, so he out-damages Cho over a long trade as long as he refuses to walk into Rupture range to start it. That's exactly why the head-to-head sits at 50.7% over 152 games: the lane rewards the Teemo who waits, not the one who engages first.

theirWindow.what: Cho can walk in and stack Vorpal Spikes autos on you, and from level 6 on he can finish with a 175-range Feast for high true damage. Disengage immediately — don't trade back into a knocked-up, slowed position, since Blinding Dart can't reach him while he closes the gap.

yourWindow.what: Step into auto range and poke freely — Toxic Shot has no cooldown so every basic attack stacks the DoT, and Blinding Dart resets every 8s to cover you if he tries to force a fight before Rupture is back up.

start.why: The 72.1% pick rate and 52.4% win rate over 147 games back it — the mana and AP keep your Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot pressure up through the poke war without needing to recall.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate over 111 games beats Sorcerer's Shoes here (44.6%) because the extra move speed lets you kite away from Rupture's slow and stay outside Feast's 175 range, which matters more than early magic pen against a melee poke-and-all-in kit.

core.why: Move speed and a wave-clearing proc let you shove and reset before Cho can walk up and punish with Vorpal Spikes.
Burn stacks hard off Toxic Shot's DoT, turning every free auto into sustained damage Cho can't trade back against.
The 54.4% win rate over 68 games on this exact path shows the ability-haste and burst amp carries into mid-game skirmishes where your R (Noxious Trap) zoning matters most.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to amplify burst onto squishier targets
the game runs long and you need raw AP scaling on your poison
you want more attack speed to stack Toxic Shot faster while kiting

runes.keystoneWhy: Press the Attack rewards landing consecutive hits, which is exactly what you're doing when you poke Cho from range while he's stuck walking toward you — three autos trigger the vulnerability proc before he's even in his own attack range.

summoners.why: 93.6% of Teemo players run this combo here at a 50.3% win rate — Ignite's DoT stacks with Toxic Shot to close out the long pokes this lane produces, and Flash keeps you clear of Rupture's knockup when Cho tries to force a fight.

playing.title: Never stand inside Rupture range
playing.detail: Rupture reaches 950 range and knocks up plus slows on hit — hold your trades at autoattack range outside that threat and let him walk into you instead.

playing.title: Poke every free auto with no cooldown
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has zero cooldown, so any safe autoattack you land is pure value — stack it whenever he's forced to step up for CS.

playing.title: Save Blind for his engage, not chip damage
playing.detail: Blinding Dart is only an 8s cooldown, but landing it right as he commits to close distance denies his Vorpal Spikes procs for the whole engage.

playing.title: Seed mushrooms on his jungle entrances early
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has a 1s cooldown and 230 range — lay them in brush and chokepoints before level 6 to deny vision of his Feast all-in and slow his approach.

playing.title: Respect Feast once he hits level 6
playing.detail: Feast is 60s cooldown but only 175 range and deals high true damage — don't facecheck brush or sit low health near him once he has it up.

playing.title: Kite with Move Quick after every trade
playing.detail: Your passive movement speed only resets when he hits you — disengage in a straight line so he can't tag you and cancel it.

playing.title: Shove waves once Statikk Shiv completes
playing.detail: He has no gap closer beyond walking and Rupture's slow, so once your wave-clear items are online you can push freely and deny him farm.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and pick rates are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — the range comparison between Rupture and Blinding Dart, the trade windows, and the Feast threat timing — is independent analysis built from the ability text, not measured data.
